messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ನಾನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದ ನಂತರ ನನ್ನ ದಣಿದ ದೇಹ, ನಾನು ಮರುಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಜನ ತೊಗಟೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡೆ, ಅದರಿಂದ ದೃಢವಾದ ಪಾದ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಕೆಳಗಿರುವುದು.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|----------------------------|--------| | Poi | temporal adverb “after” | ನಂತರ | after | OK | | ch’èi | 1st‑person perfect auxiliary “I have” | ನಾನು | I | OK | | posato | past participle of *posare* “to rest” | ಪಡೆದ | taken / had | OK | | un | indefinite article “a” | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | poco | adverb of quantity “little” | ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ | a little | OK | | il | definite article “the” (masc.) | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | corpo | noun “body” | ದೇಹ | body | OK | | lasso | adjective “weary” | ದಣಿದ | weary | OK | | ripresi | 1st‑person past “I resumed / took up again” | ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡೆ | took / resumed | OK | | via | noun “way, path” | ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು | the way | OK | | per | preposition “along, through” | ಮೂಲಕ | through / along | OK | | la | definite article “the” (fem.) | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | piaggia | noun (archaic) “slope, hillside” | ತೊಗಟೆ | slope | OK | | diserta | adjective “deserted, empty” | ನಿರ್ಜನ | deserted | OK | | sì | resultative adverb “so” | ಅದರಿಂದ | so (as a result) | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction “that” | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | ’l (article) | definite article “the” (masc.) | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | piè | noun “foot” | ಪಾದ | foot | OK | | fermo | adjective “firm, steady” | ದೃಢವಾದ | firm | OK | | sempre | adverb “always” | ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ | always | OK | | era | imperfect of *essere* “was” | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | ’l (article) | definite article “the” (masc.) | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | più | comparative particle “more / –er” | — | (none) | **UNNECESSARY** | | basso | adjective “low, lower” | ಕೆಳಗಿರುವುದು | is lower | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: *un, il, la, ’l (×3), che, era, più* – Italian articles, conjunctions, and the comparative particle have no direct lexical counterpart in Kannada and are naturally omitted. - **OK**: All other source words are represented in the Kannada translation with appropriate lexical items and correct grammatical agreement.
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 28: - Original: Poi ch'èi posato un poco il corpo lasso, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 29: - Original: ripresi via per la piaggia diserta, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 30: - Original: sì che ’l piè fermo sempre era ’l più basso. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
